comments.author: Simon
comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking Part 1: short, simple answers
comments.text:
Hi Saleh, You make a good point. IELTS examiners receive really good training, but I suppose there may be small differences between examiners. However, I wouldn't worry too much about this - focus on yourself and your own performance rather than thinking about something that is outside your control. I was an examiner for 2 years.

...

Hi Dr. Naseem,

Have a look through my task 1 lessons (in the menu on the left) - I've done a few good lessons about processes, flow charts etc.

...

Hi Jack,

You won't lose marks, but it does make it difficult for the examiner if he or she has to keep interrupting. If you notice that this is happening, you should shorten your answers a bit.

Regards

Simon
